data.title: Robo.ai Inc. Announces Reverse Stock Split and Extraordinary General Meeting on October 26, 2026
data.description: Today, on October 16, 2026, Robo.ai Inc. (Nasdaq: AIIO), a company headquartered in Dubai, UAE, shared plans for a significant change. The company is proposing a reverse stock split of 1 for every 25 ordinary shares it currently has. This decision is subject to approval by the shareholders. Robo.ai Inc. is listed on the stock exchange in the United States.

data.title: Delek US Holdings to Host Third Quarter 2026 Conference Call on November 6, 2026
data.description: Delek US Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: DK) has shared its plans to reveal its third quarter 2026 results before the U.S. stock market opens on Friday, November 6, 2026. A press release will be issued, and a conference call to discuss these results is set to commence at 10:00 a.m. CT (11:00 a.m. ET) on the same day. The live broadcast of this conference call can be accessed online at www.DelekUS.com.

data.title: Viatris Receives U.S. FDA Approval for RYZUMVI® for the Treatment of Presbyopia
data.description: Pittsburgh-based Viatris Inc. revealed that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has granted approval for RYZUMVI® (phentolamine ophthalmic solution 0.75%) for treating presbyopia in adults. This global healthcare company, listed on Nasdaq as VTRS, made the announcement on October 16, 2026.

data.title: Omnicom Schedules Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call
data.description: On October 16, 2026, Omnicom (NYSE: OMC) announced that it will release its third quarter 2026 financial results on Thursday, October 22, 2026, following the close of trading on the New York Stock Exchange. The company plans to conduct a conference call on the same day to discuss these results.

data.title: /C O R R E C T I O N - D3Energy/
data.description: A renowned Orlando theme park recently incorporated floating solar technology into its sustainability initiative. The development was announced by D3Energy on 06-Oct-2026. This integration marks a significant step towards enhancing environmental practices. The project is expected to power a substantial portion of the park's energy needs, reducing reliance on conventional sources. With this initiative, the park aims to decrease its carbon footprint by a considerable amount. The utilization of floating solar panels not only demonstrates innovation but also underscores the park's commitment to green energy solutions. This move aligns with broader efforts in the industry to promote sustainability and reduce environmental impact. Stay tuned for more updates on this transformative project.

data.title: Claude discovered how NIST ECDSA curve seeds were generated and explained some base points in timestamp data.
data.description: Anthropic reports that Claude has identified the timestamp-based generation method for NIST ECDSA curve seeds and has provided some clarification on multiple base points. This discovery sheds light on the process of generating these seeds and could have significant implications for cryptographic security.

data.title: Claude boosts quantum circuit efficiency, enhancing 8 designs with significant reductions in qubits & gates, some by orders of magnitude.
data.description: Anthropic reported that Claude enhanced a total of eight quantum circuit designs by reducing the number of qubits and gates, resulting in significant improvements. Some advancements even reached ten times their original efficiency.

data.title: Up to 10x agent signups seen with ChatGPT plugin on Stack Overflow for Agents, built in weeks with Codex.
data.description: The development of Stack Overflow for Agents by OpenAI, utilizing Codex technology, took only weeks. This initiative reported a significant surge in agent creation, with growth rates of up to 10 times, as a result of incorporating the ChatGPT plugin. This information suggests that the integration of ChatGPT has had a notable impact on the efficiency and productivity of creating agents on the platform.

data.title: RWAs transition from tokenization to on-chain utility, says Binance. Assets gain on-chain functions and automation.
data.description: Binance has reported that programmable real-world assets are undergoing a transformation from tokenized assets to assets that feature on-chain functionality and automation. This shift marks a significant development in the crypto space, highlighting the integration of technological advancements to enhance the functionality of assets.

data.title: AMD now offers day-0 backing for Meta's Muse Spark Open, powered by Instinct MI350X and MI355X GPUs on ROCm and vLLM platforms, featuring BF16, MXFP4, and FP8 options.
data.description: AMD announced that their Instinct MI350X and MI355X graphics processing units now support Meta's Muse Spark Open on ROCm and vLLM platforms. These GPUs come in three variants: BF16, MXFP4, and FP8, highlighting enhanced performance and compatibility.

data.title: NVIDIA's RTX Spark localizes AI coding workflows on a single PC with local coding agents, AI frameworks, and Windows-on-Arm tools.
data.description: NVIDIA introduces RTX Spark, a platform that merges coding agents, AI frameworks, and Windows-on-Arm tools on a single machine, streamlining development processes. This integration paves the way for easier and more efficient software development.
